zh.title: 烏克蘭稱攻擊俄羅斯空軍基地 5架軍機受損
zh.summary: 烏克蘭稱攻擊俄羅斯空軍基地，3架MiG-31及2架Su-34受損。
body: 烏克蘭表示，烏方攻擊俄羅斯Savasleyka空軍基地，造成3架MiG-31戰鬥機及2架Su-34戰鬥轟炸機受損。
Savasleyka空軍基地位於俄羅斯下諾夫哥羅德地區，地處莫斯科以東。烏克蘭參謀總部表示，這次攻擊發生於2026年11月24日及隔夜至25日的一系列打擊行動期間。
初步評估認為，這5架軍機將有一段時間無法飛行。軍方表示，此次攻擊造成的受損程度及受波及的軍機數量仍在評估中。

en.title: Ukraine says strike on Russian air base damaged five military jets
en.summary: Ukraine says its strike on a Russian air base damaged three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.
body: Ukraine said its strike on Russia’s Savasleyka air base damaged three MiG-31 fighters and two Su-34 fighter-bombers.

The Savasleyka air base is located in Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod region, to the east of Moscow. Ukraine’s General Staff said the attack took place during a series of strikes on November 24 and overnight into November 25, 2026.

The preliminary assessment indicated that all five of the aircraft would be unable to fly for some time. The military said it was still assessing the extent of the damage and the number of jets affected.

zh.title: 巴西航空工業與ALADA簽協議 推動KC-390與A-29政府間銷售
zh.summary: 巴西航空工業與ALADA簽框架協議，擬拓展拉美及非洲政府間銷售。
body: 巴西航空工業與巴西國營航太公司ALADA於2026年11月25日在巴西利亞的Mostra BID簽署框架協議，擬透過政府對政府採購模式，推動KC-390 Millennium與A-29 Super Tucano的銷售。
協議為評估及發展拉丁美洲與非洲的潛在商機訂出指引。2026年4月7日，智利聖地牙哥的FIDAE航展期間曾簽署一份諒解備忘錄，當時兩家公司開始探討政府對政府銷售機會。
ALADA受巴西國防部委託協助政府對政府銷售。當外國政府對巴西國防裝備表達興趣時，國防部可指派ALADA處理交易、簽署出口合約，並協助買方選擇巴西供應商。

en.title: Embraer and ALADA sign KC-390 and A-29 government-to-government sales framework
en.summary: Embraer and ALADA sign a framework for potential government-to-government sales in Latin America and Africa.
body: Embraer and Brazil’s state-owned aerospace company ALADA signed a framework agreement at Mostra BID in Brasília, Brazil, on November 25, 2026, to facilitate government-to-government sales of the KC-390 Millennium and A-29 Super Tucano.

The agreement sets guidelines for assessing and developing potential business opportunities in Latin America and Africa. A memorandum of understanding was signed at the FIDAE air show in Santiago, Chile, on April 7, 2026, when the two companies began exploring government-to-government sales opportunities.

ALADA has been tasked by Brazil’s Ministry of Defense with facilitating government-to-government sales. When a foreign government expresses interest in Brazilian defense equipment, the ministry can appoint ALADA to handle the transaction, sign export contracts and help the buyer select a Brazilian supplier.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦國際航空兩班英國航班取消，將改派自家波音 777
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦國際航空表示，濕租合作夥伴 Norse Atlantic 突然停止提供服務，兩班從英國出發的航班取消。航空公司計畫自 11 月 26 日起，由自家波音 777 機隊接手英國航班。
body: 巴基斯坦國際航空 11 月 25 日表示，倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）飛伊斯蘭馬巴德的 PK786，以及曼徹斯特機場（MAN）飛拉合爾的 PK710 航班取消。航空公司稱，旅客準備登機時才收到濕租合作夥伴 Norse Atlantic 停止服務的通知。
巴基斯坦國際航空宣布，將自 11 月 26 日起以自家波音 777 執飛英國航班。這次公布的是巴基斯坦國際航空的航班變更。

en.title: PIA cancels two UK flights and plans to switch to its own Boeing 777s
en.summary: Pakistan International Airlines says two UK departures were cancelled after wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic stopped providing service. PIA plans to assign its own Boeing 777s to UK flights from November 26.
body: Pakistan International Airlines said on November 25 that it cancelled PK786 from London Heathrow (LHR) to Islamabad and PK710 from Manchester (MAN) to Lahore. PIA said wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic notified it of the suspension as passengers were preparing to board.
PIA said it would assign its own Boeing 777 fleet to UK services beginning November 26. Under the previous wet-lease arrangement, Norse Atlantic provided the aircraft and crew.

zh.title: NASA 正式接收 X-59 超音速研究機，將繼續試飛
zh.summary: 美國國家航空暨太空總署已自洛克希德馬丁接收 X-59。NASA 將繼續試飛，研究如何降低陸上超音速飛行的音爆噪音。
body: 美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）11 月 23 日公布，已於 11 月 18 日正式取得 X-59 超音速研究機的所有權。交接前，洛克希德馬丁的 Skunk Works 團隊一直持有該機，並與 NASA 推進驗收審查。
X-59 於 2025 年 10 月首飛，之後以加州阿姆斯壯飛行研究中心為試飛基地。NASA 接手後將繼續試飛，洛克希德馬丁視需要提供支援。
NASA 的 Quesst 計畫將測量飛越時的噪音並蒐集民眾反應，供監管機關評估陸上民航超音速飛行的噪音標準。

en.title: NASA takes ownership of X-59 and will continue supersonic flight tests
en.summary: NASA has taken ownership of the X-59 from Lockheed Martin and will continue testing how to reduce the noise produced by supersonic flight over land.
body: NASA announced on November 23 that ownership of the X-59 aircraft transferred to the agency on November 18. Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works team had retained ownership while working through an acceptance review with NASA.
The X-59 first flew in October 2025 and has since been based at Armstrong Flight Research Center in California. NASA will continue flight testing, with Lockheed Martin providing support as needed.

The Quesst mission will gather noise measurements and community responses to flyovers. NASA plans to share those results with regulators considering noise standards for civilian supersonic flight over land.

zh.title: 美國擬對巴西製飛機加徵10%關稅 巴西政府強烈反彈
zh.summary: 美國提議對巴西製飛機加徵10%關稅；巴西政府反彈並尋求協商
body: 美國政府提議對巴西製造的飛機加徵10%關稅。巴西政府強烈反彈，指控美方企圖藉關稅施壓，迫使巴西調整國內政策，並表示不會向此類威脅讓步。
美國貿易代表署（USTR）公佈的方案指出，美方認為巴西未充分回應華府對部分經貿議題的關切，因此建議修改先前依據「301條款」採取的措施，將原本獲豁免的巴西飛機納入課稅範圍。若新措施正式實施，巴西航空工業（Embraer）出口至美國的整架飛機將面臨額外10%關稅壓力。
巴西政府表示，將持續尋求透過協商解決爭端，但不排除在世界貿易組織（WTO）架構下採取法律行動，也保留依對等原則祭出反制措施的可能性。

en.title: U.S. Proposes Extra 10% Tariff on Brazilian-Made Aircraft; Brazil Objects
en.summary: U.S. proposes an extra 10% tariff on Brazilian-made aircraft; Brazil objects and seeks talks.
body: The U.S. government has proposed an additional 10% tariff on Brazilian-made aircraft. Brazil's government strongly objected, accusing Washington of using tariffs to pressure it to change domestic policies and saying it would not yield to such threats.

A plan published by the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) says Washington considers Brazil's response to some trade concerns inadequate and proposes amending Section 301 measures to include Brazilian aircraft that were previously exempt. If the new measures take effect, complete aircraft exported to the United States by Embraer would face an additional 10% tariff.

Brazil says it will continue seeking a negotiated settlement but has not ruled out legal action under the World Trade Organization (WTO) framework. It has also reserved the possibility of taking reciprocal countermeasures.

zh.title: GE Aerospace執行長宣佈$100,000捐款 支持軍人轉職航空維修培訓
zh.summary: GE Aerospace執行長宣佈$100,000捐款，將補助轉職軍人學費及考試費。
body: GE Aerospace董事長兼執行長Larry Culp在Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University的Daytona Beach校區宣佈一筆$100,000捐款，支持該校的航空維修技術SkillBridge計畫。這筆捐款將協助計畫中準備轉職的服役人員支付學費及聯邦航空總署（FAA）考試費。
GE Aerospace表示，SkillBridge讓準備離開軍隊的人員在服役的最後數月，透過參與計畫的企業與學校接受訓練，為投入民間職涯做準備。
GE Aerospace也指出，Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University在部分軍事基地開設一門一般航空維修課程，協助學員在離開軍隊前朝取得機體與動力裝置證照邁進。

en.title: GE Aerospace CEO announces $100,000 donation for service members' aviation training
en.summary: GE Aerospace's CEO announces a $100,000 donation to help transitioning service members cover tuition and testing costs.
body: GE Aerospace Chairman and CEO Larry Culp announced a $100,000 donation to Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University’s Aviation Maintenance Technology SkillBridge program at the university’s Daytona Beach campus. The donation will help cover tuition and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) testing expenses for transitioning service members in the program, the company said.

The SkillBridge program allows service members transitioning out of the military to use their final months in uniform to train with participating companies and schools for civilian careers, according to GE Aerospace.

GE Aerospace said one Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University course offered at select military bases focuses on general aviation maintenance. It helps participants work toward an airframe and powerplant certification before leaving the military.

facts.claim: JetBlue's busiest A320 route in 2026 is Orlando–San Juan, with 3,562 flights in both directions and 572,976 seats, over an average sector length of 1,189 miles, according to Cirium data cited by Simple Flying.
All 11 of JetBlue's busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida; Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia recorded 3,350 combined flights and Fort Lauderdale–San Juan 3,280.
JetBlue said it intended to reach around 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale by year-end, after its July announcement put summer departures near 130, more than 75% above 2025 levels.
Fort Lauderdale is now JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, with roughly 21,500 winter departures against nearly 13,700 a year earlier.
The A320 accounts for 129 of JetBlue's 298 aircraft as of September 30, 2026, and its fleet plan lists seven A220 deliveries in 2027, nine in 2028, 10 in 2029, and two in 2030.
JetBlue reported a third-quarter loss of $257 million, with cash falling from $1.95 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.26 billion in September, and is targeting sustained profitability in 2027.

zh.title: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙A320航線全在佛州 奧蘭多—聖胡安居冠
zh.summary: 根據Cirium數據，捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的A320航線是奧蘭多—聖胡安，全年雙向共3562班次；最繁忙的11條A320航線全數觸及佛州，反映該公司在精神航空退出後加速擴張佛州網絡。
body: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的空中巴士A320航線不是橫貫大陸的商務幹線，而是奧蘭多—聖胡安。根據Cirium數據，這條航線雙向全年共飛航3562班次、提供約57.3萬個座位，平均航程1189英里。更值得注意的是，最繁忙的11條A320城市對全數觸及佛州：勞德岱堡—拉瓜迪亞以3350班次居次，勞德岱堡—聖胡安以3280班次排名第三。

佛州擴張的直接推力是精神航空倒閉留下的缺口。捷藍7月宣布，夏季自勞德岱堡出發的班次接近每日130班，較2025年增加逾75%，目標是年底前達到每日約150班；按冬季班表計算，勞德岱堡已是捷藍起降班次最多的機場，約2.15萬班，高於一年前的約1.37萬班。機隊方面，截至2026年9月30日，A320佔捷藍298架飛機中的129架，而A220預計2027年交付7架、2028年9架、2029年10架、2030年2架。財務壓力仍在：捷藍第三季虧損2.57億美元，現金自2025年底的19.5億美元降至9月的12.6億美元，目標是2027年恢復持續獲利。

en.title: JetBlue's busiest A320 flights in 2026 all touch Florida
en.summary: Cirium data shows JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is Orlando–San Juan, with 3,562 flights in both directions, and all 11 of its busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida, reflecting the airline's rapid Florida expansion after Spirit Airlines' collapse.
body: JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is not a transcontinental link between two major business centres. According to Cirium, it is Orlando–San Juan, a leisure-heavy connection that recorded 3,562 flights in both directions, offering 572,976 seats across an average sector length of 1,189 miles. More revealing still, all 11 of the airline's busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida: Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia follows with 3,350 combined flights and 542,688 seats, and Fort Lauderdale–San Juan with 3,280 flights and 531,288 seats.

The immediate catalyst is Spirit Airlines' collapse. JetBlue moved to fill part of the gap and said it intended to reach around 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale by year-end; its July announcement put summer departures near 130, more than 75% above 2025 levels. According to Simple Flying, citing Cirium schedule data, Fort Lauderdale is now JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, with roughly 21,500 winter departures against nearly 13,700 a year earlier. On fleet, the A320 accounts for 129 of JetBlue's 298 aircraft as of September 30, 2026, while its fleet plan lists seven A220 deliveries in 2027, nine in 2028, 10 in 2029, and two in 2030. The finances remain strained: the airline reported a third-quarter loss of $257 million, with cash falling from $1.95 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.26 billion in September, and it is targeting sustained profitability in 2027.

zh.title: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）衝出跑道 觸發FAA地面停飛措施
zh.summary: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機於邁阿密國際機場（MIA）26R跑道衝出跑道，觸發FAA地面停飛。
body: 據AeroTime報導，一架聯邦快遞（FedEx Express）麥道MD-11貨機於2026年11月25日晚間，在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）降落時衝出跑道。這起事件發生在美國感恩節假期前夕，導致該機場四條跑道中的三條被迫關閉，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）實施地面停飛措施。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）確認，涉事航機為聯邦快遞910號班機（FedEx Flight 910），該航班稍早從位於曼菲斯的Frederick W. Smith International Airport（MEM）起飛前往邁阿密。邁阿密機場官員進一步說明，該架貨機係在26R跑道降落時衝出跑道範圍。
在人員安全方面，Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office表示，這架聯邦快遞MD-11貨機上共有兩名人員，事發後並未傳出任何人員受傷的報告。
由於四條跑道中有三條因這起衝出跑道事件而關閉，邁阿密國際機場（MIA）的航班運作受到顯著影響，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的地面停飛措施。AeroTime報導指出，機場的航班中斷與延誤情況持續至2026年11月26日凌晨，FAA通報現場出現長達數小時的航班延誤。
在機隊背景方面，聯邦快遞於2026年5月才剛恢復MD-11機型的飛航運作。此前，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）曾於2025年11月對該型機實施停飛令，直到2026年5月解除停飛令後，聯邦快遞才重新派遣MD-11貨機執飛任務。

en.title: FedEx MD-11 overruns runway at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggers FAA ground stop
en.summary: A FedEx Express MD-11 freighter overran Runway 26R at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggering an FAA ground stop.
body: A FedEx Express McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter overran a runway while landing at Miami International Airport (MIA) on the evening of November 25, 2026, according to a report published by AeroTime. The landing overrun occurred on the eve of the US Thanksgiving holiday, forcing the closure of three of the airport’s four runways and triggering a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ground stop.

In its identification of the aircraft, the FAA confirmed that the freighter was operating as FedEx Flight 910, which had departed from Frederick W. Smith International Airport (MEM) in Memphis. Miami airport officials stated that the aircraft overran Runway 26R while landing at the airport.

The Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office reported that two people were on board the McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter when the overrun occurred at Miami International Airport. According to the sheriff’s office, no injuries were reported as a result of the incident.

Because three of the four runways at Miami International Airport were forced to close following the overrun, the FAA ground stop had an immediate impact on traffic ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday. AeroTime reported that operational disruptions continued into the early hours of November 26, 2026, with the FAA reporting delays of several hours.

The overrun also comes months after the cargo carrier returned the aircraft type to service. According to AeroTime, FedEx resumed MD-11 flights in May 2026 after the FAA lifted a grounding of the MD-11 aircraft type that had originally been imposed in November 2025.

zh.title: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6,000萬歐元 推動ATR72水陸兩棲消防機計畫
zh.summary: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6千萬歐元建ATR72消防機設施。
body: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6,000萬歐元，規劃興建兩座製造設施，推動ATR72水陸兩棲消防機改裝計畫。公司計畫在土魯斯（Toulouse）投入3,600萬歐元，設立主要工廠，改裝ATR72渦輪螺旋槳飛機。
另有2,400萬歐元將投入法國西北部Vannes的新工廠，生產安裝於改裝後ATR72的浮筒。浮筒將在Groupe Carboman子公司Multiplast協力下生產。
這項投資宣佈前不久，Positive Aviation獲選為「Première Usine」計畫第11批項目之一；該計畫與France 2030倡議相關。AeroTime引述多家媒體報導，該公司截至2026年11月約籌得3,000萬歐元，其中約一半來自私人投資人。

en.title: Positive Aviation announces €60 million for amphibious ATR72 firefighting project
en.summary: Positive Aviation plans a €60 million investment in two facilities for amphibious ATR72 firefighting conversions.
body: Positive Aviation, a French startup, has announced a €60 million investment to build two manufacturing facilities for its amphibious ATR72 firefighting conversion project. It plans to invest €36 million in its planned main facility in Toulouse, dedicated to retrofitting the turboprops.

A further €24 million is earmarked for a new factory in Vannes, northwestern France, to produce floats for the converted ATR72s. The floats will be made in collaboration with Multiplast, a subsidiary of Groupe Carboman.

The announcement came shortly after Positive Aviation was selected for the 11th batch of the Première Usine programme, associated with the France 2030 initiative. Citing multiple media sources, AeroTime reported that the startup had raised approximately €30 million by November 2026, with around half from private investors.

zh.title: 美同意對烏克蘭提供 F-16 維保軍售方案 由歐洲四國出資
zh.summary: 美國國務院同意可能的 F-16 維保軍售，估值6.219億美元，由比利時、丹麥、荷蘭與挪威出資。
body: AeroTime 引述美國國務院11月25日的國會通知報導，美方同意一項可能向烏克蘭出售的 F-16 維保設備與服務方案，估值6.219億美元。
烏克蘭空軍表示，款項將由比利時、丹麥、荷蘭與挪威出資。美方通知指出，相關設備和服務將納入既有軍售案。公告金額屬估算，實際金額以後續安排為準。

en.title: U.S. clears possible F-16 sustainment sale to Ukraine with European funding
en.summary: Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway are to fund a possible U.S. sale estimated at $621.9 million.
body: The U.S. State Department cleared a possible sale of F-16 sustainment equipment and services to Ukraine, AeroTime reported, citing a November 25 congressional notification. The package has an estimated value of $621.9 million.

Ukraine’s Air Force said Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway would fund the purchase. The equipment and services would be added to an existing foreign military sales case. The announced figure is an estimate.

facts.claim: Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway are to fund a possible U.S. sale estimated at $621.9 million.

zh.title: 美國海軍增訂3架 E-130J 測試機
zh.summary: 美國海軍執行約11.3億美元的合約選擇權，使 E-130J 開發案的已訂測試機增至6架。
body: 美國海軍依既有合約執行選擇權，委託諾斯洛普格魯曼設計、開發並交付3架 E-130J Phoenix II 系統驗證測試機。11月25日公佈的合約修改價值約11.3億美元，另涵蓋初期備料。
AeroTime 報導，這筆訂單使該計畫所訂購的測試機增至6架。E-130J 是美國海軍的空中戰略通訊機開發計畫，本次公佈的是開發合約。

en.title: U.S. Navy orders three more E-130J test aircraft
en.summary: A $1.13 billion contract option brings the number of E-130J test aircraft under contract to six.
body: The U.S. Navy exercised an option under an existing Northrop Grumman contract to design, develop and deliver three E-130J Phoenix II system demonstration test aircraft. The contract modification, announced on November 25, is valued at about $1.13 billion and also covers initial spares.
AeroTime reported that the order brings the program’s total under contract to six test aircraft. The E-130J is an airborne strategic communications development program.

facts.claim: A $1.13 billion contract option brings the number of E-130J test aircraft under contract to six.

zh.title: 俄羅斯軍事法院裁定羈押空天軍副司令格列霍夫
zh.summary: 俄媒引述法院紀錄指出，負責裝備的空天軍副司令格列霍夫遭羈押。俄媒稱案件涉及收賄指控。
body: 俄羅斯《生意人報》查閱法院紀錄後報導，莫斯科第235衛戍軍事法院11月25日批准調查人員的聲請，裁定羈押俄羅斯空天軍負責裝備的副司令格列霍夫。
該報引述消息人士稱，格列霍夫面臨收賄指控。AeroTime 報導，格列霍夫否認指控。俄媒尚未交代據稱涉案的金額或與哪一項採購有關。

en.title: Russian military court orders detention of Aerospace Forces deputy chief Grekhov
en.summary: Russian media said a Moscow court ordered the deputy chief responsible for armaments held in connection with a bribery allegation.
body: Kommersant reported that Moscow’s 235th Garrison Military Court granted investigators’ request to hold Yuri Grekhov in pretrial detention on November 25. He is the Russian Aerospace Forces deputy commander-in-chief responsible for armaments.

The newspaper cited sources who said the case concerns alleged bribery. AeroTime reported that Grekhov denies the charge. The reports did not identify an alleged payment amount or link the case to a specific procurement contract.

facts.claim: Russian media said a Moscow court ordered the deputy chief responsible for armaments held in connection with a bribery allegation.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦國際航空改用自有777 恢復英國航班
zh.summary: Norse Atlantic 暫停代飛後，巴基斯坦國際航空改以自有波音777接手英國航班。
body: 路透社報導，巴基斯坦國際航空11月26日宣佈恢復英國航班，改以自有波音777機隊執飛。此前，提供飛機及機組的 Norse Atlantic 暫停代飛，導致11月25日自倫敦和曼徹斯特起飛的兩班航班取消。
Norse Atlantic 10月曾宣佈以兩架波音787-9提供含機組的濕租服務。巴基斯坦國際航空表示，正評估後續機隊安排，包括其他臨時運能方案。

en.title: PIA restores UK flights using its own Boeing 777 fleet
en.summary: Pakistan International Airlines switched to its own Boeing 777s after wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic suspended operations.
body: Pakistan International Airlines said on November 26 that it had restored UK services using its own Boeing 777 fleet, Reuters reported. A suspension by its wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic forced the cancellation of two flights from London and Manchester a day earlier.

Norse Atlantic had announced in October that it would provide two Boeing 787-9s with crews under the lease. PIA said it was assessing further fleet arrangements, including other temporary capacity options.

facts.claim: Pakistan International Airlines switched to its own Boeing 777s after wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic suspended operations.

zh.summary: GOL Premium 將於2027年2月15日上路，前3排保留中間座位不售，每架提供12席。

en.title: Brazil’s GOL airline to add premium seating across its Boeing 737 fleet
en.summary: GOL Premium launches on February 15, 2027, with 12 seats in the first three rows and the middle seats blocked.
body: GOL said its Boeing 737-700, 737-800 and 737 MAX 8 fleet will adopt a new seating structure from February 15, 2027. It applies to domestic and international flights, with sales opening on December 15, 2026.

GOL Premium will occupy the first three rows, offering 12 seats per aircraft by blocking the middle seats. It replaces the existing international premium economy product and brings the new product to domestic flights.

en.summary: Several routes that Air India stopped flying in 2026 continued under its subsidiary Air India Express.
body: A Simple Flying review identified 17 nonstop routes that Air India stopped operating in 2026. Delhi services to Birmingham, Vienna and Copenhagen ended in October or November.
Some routes remained in the wider group network. Air India Express took over services such as Hyderabad–Dubai, Chennai–Singapore and Mumbai–Coimbatore. The tally reflects changes across the year.

zh.summary: 美國國務院批准可能對烏克蘭軍售F-16支援，四國將支付預估6.219億美元。
body: 美國國務院已批准一項可能對烏克蘭出售F-16維持運作設備及相關支援的軍售案，預估金額為6.219億美元。比利時、丹麥、荷蘭及挪威將負擔全額費用。
國務院在2026年11月25日公佈的國會通知中表示，烏克蘭將透過Joint Ukraine Multinational Program – Services, Training and Articles Rapid Timeline（JUMPSTART）為採購籌措資金。基輔要求取得藥筒驅動及推進劑驅動裝置（CAD/PAD）、實驗室設備及運輸支援。
相關設備與服務將列入一項既有的對外軍售案件，該案先前的金額低於需要通知國會的門檻。國務院未說明預估6.219億美元中，原有案件與新增項目各佔多少。

en.title: US State Department approves possible F-16 support sale to Ukraine; four allies to pay
en.summary: The U.S. State Department approved a possible $621.9 million F-16 support sale to Ukraine; four allies would pay.
body: The U.S. State Department has approved a possible $621.9 million Foreign Military Sale (FMS) of F-16 sustainment equipment and related support to Ukraine. Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway will cover the full cost.

In a congressional notification published on November 25, 2026, the department said Ukraine would finance the purchase through the Joint Ukraine Multinational Program – Services, Training and Articles Rapid Timeline (JUMPSTART). Kyiv requested cartridge-actuated and propellant-actuated devices (CAD/PAD), laboratory equipment and transportation support.

The equipment and services are to be added to an existing FMS case whose value was previously below the threshold for congressional notification. The State Department did not specify how the estimated $621.9 million was divided between the original case and the additional items.

zh.title: 荷蘭皇家航空2027年夏季班表暫未列阿姆斯特丹至澤西航班
zh.summary: Simple Flying 查閱班表後報導，荷蘭皇家航空目前未排定2027年夏季的阿姆斯特丹至澤西航班。
body: Simple Flying 報導，截至11月26日，荷蘭皇家航空的2027年夏季班表未列阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場（AMS）至澤西機場（JER）的航班。該媒體已向航空公司詢問是否永久退出，仍待回覆。
澤西港務局先前公告，該航線於2026年4月開航，由 KLM Cityhopper 執飛，7至8月旺季增至每日一班。2026年的公告涵蓋至10月24日。

en.title: KLM’s summer 2027 schedule currently shows no Amsterdam–Jersey flights
en.summary: Simple Flying reported that KLM had not scheduled Amsterdam–Jersey flights for summer 2027.
body: As of November 26, KLM’s summer 2027 timetable did not list flights between Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS) and Jersey, Simple Flying reported. The publication said it had asked the airline whether the withdrawal was permanent.

Ports of Jersey announced that the service began in April 2026 and was operated by KLM Cityhopper. The route increased to daily service at the July and August peak. The announced 2026 schedule ran through October 24.

facts.claim: Simple Flying reported that KLM had not scheduled Amsterdam–Jersey flights for summer 2027.

zh.title: 捷藍航空11月國際班表較去年少11條航線
zh.summary: Simple Flying 比較兩年11月的班表，發現捷藍航空較去年少11條國際航線，減班集中在紐約與紐華克。
body: Simple Flying 以 Cirium Diio 資料比較捷藍航空2025年及2026年11月班表，發現去年同期執飛的11條國際航線今年已從班表移除，多數原從紐約甘迺迪或紐華克機場出發。
報導列出的航線包括波士頓至阿姆斯特丹、紐約甘迺迪至貝里斯市，以及紐華克至坎昆。這些路線在2026年不同時間停飛。

en.title: JetBlue’s November schedule has 11 fewer international routes than a year earlier
en.summary: A comparison of November timetables found 11 international routes had disappeared, mostly from New York JFK and Newark.
body: Simple Flying compared November 2025 and November 2026 schedules using Cirium Diio data. It identified 11 JetBlue international routes flown a year earlier that had been removed from the schedule, most of them from New York JFK (JFK) or Newark.
The list includes Boston–Amsterdam, New York JFK–Belize City and Newark–Cancún. The services stopped at different points during 2026.

facts.claim: A comparison of November timetables found 11 international routes had disappeared, mostly from New York JFK and Newark.

zh.title: Carmine Sky雷射系統據報擊落俄羅斯噴射動力Geran無人機
zh.summary: Carmine Sky雷射系統據報擊落俄羅斯噴射無人機；攔截時間地點未透露
body: 烏克蘭企業Carmine Sky研發的雷射防空系統，據報擊落一架俄羅斯噴射動力Geran無人機。這項說法來自烏克蘭總統顧問、無線電技術專家Serhii “Flash” Beskrestnov。他於2026年11月25日表示，名為Blysk的雷射系統被部署用來保護一處關鍵基礎設施。
Beskrestnov分享一段21秒的攔截影片，但未透露攔截發生的時間、地點或交戰距離。
Blysk雷射系統正透過烏克蘭政府支持的Private Air Defense計畫研發。

en.title: Carmine Sky laser reportedly downs Russian jet-powered Geran drone
en.summary: Carmine Sky laser reportedly shot down a Russian jet-powered drone; timing and location were not disclosed.
body: A laser air defense system developed by Ukrainian company Carmine Sky reportedly shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone, according to Serhii “Flash” Beskrestnov, a radio technology specialist and adviser to Ukraine’s president. On November 25, 2026, Beskrestnov said the laser, known as Blysk, had been deployed to protect a critical infrastructure facility.
Beskrestnov shared a 21-second video of the reported interception, but did not disclose when or where it took place or the range at which it was carried out.
The Blysk laser is being developed under Ukraine’s state-backed Private Air Defense program.

zh.title: 科威特無人機爆炸後 兩名萊茵金屬義大利籍員工死亡
zh.summary: 萊茵金屬兩名義大利籍員工在科威特無人機爆炸後死亡，義大利外交部證實
body: 義大利外交部證實，兩名在萊茵金屬（Rheinmetall）工作的義大利公民，在科威特發生無人機爆炸後死亡。義大利當局表示，無人機攻擊發生時，Rheinmetall Italia員工正在維護Skyguard防空系統的偵測天線。
國防部發言人Saud Al-Atwan上校說，科威特武裝部隊在該國領空偵測到數架敵方無人機，並曾交戰。他將攻擊歸咎於伊朗，稱一處「重要設施」遭到攻擊。
他說，4名傷者包括兩名義大利人、1名科威特人及1名巴基斯坦人；其中兩名義大利人死亡。

en.title: Two Italian Rheinmetall workers killed after drone explosion in Kuwait
en.summary: Two Italian Rheinmetall workers died after a drone explosion in Kuwait, Italy’s foreign ministry said.
body: Italy’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that two Italian nationals working for Rheinmetall were killed in Kuwait following a drone explosion. Italian authorities said the Rheinmetall Italia workers were maintaining detection antennas for the Skyguard anti-aircraft defense system when the drone strike occurred.

Defense Ministry spokesman Colonel Saud Al-Atwan said Kuwait’s armed forces had detected several hostile drones in the country’s airspace and had engaged. He blamed Iran for an attack on what he called a “vital site”.
Al-Atwan said the four people injured were two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and a Pakistani national. The two Italians died, according to the Italian ministry.

zh.title: 美國感恩節惡劣天候幹擾航班 396班取消、948班延誤
zh.summary: FlightAware統計美國航班396班取消、948班延誤，感恩節天候惡劣
body: 美國感恩節當天遭逢惡劣天候，航空運作受到幹擾。FlightAware資料顯示，截至美東時間11月26日10時46分，美國境內、飛往美國及自美國出發的航班已有396班取消。同一資料另顯示948班延誤。
一場沿岸風暴正為美國東北部帶來豪雨、淹水與強風，並影響服務紐約和波士頓的主要航空樞紐。巴爾的摩／華盛頓國際機場受到較嚴重衝擊，週四稍早約有四分之一的預定起飛航班取消。
達美航空已發布涵蓋9座機場的天候豁免措施。符合資格的旅客可將感恩節航班改訂為11月28日或之前的行程，無須支付票價差額。

en.title: Severe weather disrupts US Thanksgiving flights, with 396 canceled and 948 delayed
en.summary: FlightAware recorded 396 US flight cancellations and 948 delays as severe weather disrupted Thanksgiving operations.
body: Severe weather has disrupted US flight operations on Thanksgiving Day, with hundreds of flights canceled. FlightAware data showed that, as of 10:46 Eastern time on Nov. 26, 396 flights within, into or out of the US had been canceled. The data also showed a further 948 flights delayed.

A coastal storm is bringing heavy rain, flooding and strong winds to the northeastern US and affecting major aviation hubs serving New York and Boston. At Baltimore/Washington International Airport, around a quarter of scheduled departures had been canceled earlier on Thursday.
Delta Air Lines has issued a weather waiver covering nine airports. Eligible passengers can rebook Thanksgiving flights for travel through Nov. 28 without paying a fare difference.

zh.title: 美空軍持續升級B-52轟炸機 規劃投入210億美元
zh.summary: 美空軍正升級B-52轟炸機；規劃投入210億美元更新現役機隊
body: 美國空軍正持續升級波音B-52轟炸機機隊。政府監督機構GAO的一篇文章指出，空軍規劃投入210億美元，更新70多架現役B-52。
Aerospace Global News報導，空軍目前正推動將B-52H機隊升級為B-52J型。這項現代化計畫將為現役機隊提供新的勞斯萊斯F130發動機。
B-52於1955年服役。報導稱，這項升級可能讓該機型在美國空軍的服役時間達到100年。

en.title: US Air Force upgrades B-52 bombers, plans $21 billion for modernization
en.summary: US Air Force is upgrading B-52 bombers and plans $21 billion in fleet modernization spending.
body: The US Air Force is currently upgrading its Boeing B-52 bomber fleet. An article by the government watchdog GAO says the Air Force plans to spend $21 billion modernizing its remaining 70-plus active B-52 aircraft.

Aerospace Global News reports that the Air Force is working to upgrade the B-52H fleet to the B-52J variant. The modernization will provide the aircraft with new Rolls-Royce F130 engines, according to the report.
The B-52 entered service in 1955. The report says the ongoing upgrade could see the aircraft reach 100 years of service with the US Air Force.

zh.title: NASA派3架研究機赴愛荷華 監測疊氮化鉛引爆作業
zh.summary: NASA派3架研究機赴愛荷華，任務為收集疊氮化鉛引爆期間的環境資料。
body: 美國太空總署（NASA）派出3架研究飛機前往愛荷華州，目的是收集疊氮化鉛引爆期間的大氣與環境資料。這項引爆行動於11月25日進行。
參與的機型包括NASA維吉尼亞州蘭利研究中心的洛克希德P-3 Orion與Gulfstream III，以及由艾姆斯研究中心以合約方式使用的Beechcraft King Air B200。
美國陸軍在Middletown的愛荷華陸軍彈藥廠，以受控方式引爆近4.5公噸不穩定爆炸物。太空中的TEMPO儀器觀測資料，也納入聯邦單位協調應對這項行動的工作。
美國環境保護署表示，其空氣監測設備在引爆前、引爆期間及緊接其後，均未檢出空氣中的鉛。

en.title: NASA deploys three research aircraft to monitor Iowa lead azide detonation
en.summary: NASA sent three research aircraft to Iowa to collect environmental data during a lead azide detonation.
body: NASA deployed three research aircraft to Iowa to collect atmospheric and environmental data during a lead azide detonation on November 25.
The aircraft included a Lockheed P-3 Orion and a Gulfstream III from NASA’s Langley Research Center in Virginia, and a Beechcraft King Air B200 contracted by the agency’s Ames Research Center.

The US Army carried out a controlled detonation of nearly 4.5 metric tonnes of unstable explosive material at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown. Observations from the space-based TEMPO instrument formed part of a coordinated federal response to the operation.
The US Environmental Protection Agency said its air monitoring equipment detected no airborne lead before, during or immediately after the detonation.

en.title: Ukrainian laser appears to down Russian jet-powered Geran-4 drone
en.summary: Serhii Flash posted a video that appears to show a Russian Geran-4 drone downed by laser.
body: Ukrainian Telegram channel Serhii Flash posted a video that appears to show a Russian jet-powered Geran-4 drone being shot down by a laser, Aerospace Global News reported.

The post attributed the apparent shootdown to Ukraine’s Blysk air-defence laser systems, developed by Ukrainian defence-technology company Carmine Sky. The video appears to show the system acquiring and tracking the Geran-4 before engaging it with a laser, according to the report.

The channel is owned by Serhii Beskrestnov, an adviser to the Ukrainian president on technology. Beskrestnov cautioned that it was too early to discuss serial production of Carmine Sky’s laser system.

zh.summary: 劍橋大學提常態調整部分航班高度；盼減少英國管理空域持續性凝結尾
body: 劍橋大學研究人員在政策簡報中提出，在英國管理的空域常態調整航班飛行高度。研究人員表示，部分航班上升或下降約2,000英呎，可能避免形成持續性凝結尾。簡報於11月18日COP31期間發布。
Aviation Impact Accelerator（AIA）估計，2%至5%的航班造成80%至90%的凝結尾暖化效應。劍橋大學估計，有針對性的規避措施可能使航空公司整體機隊的平均燃油消耗增加約0.1%。
另一項估計指出，避開持續性凝結尾可能讓航空業的氣候影響近乎減半，但成效取決於預報準確度，以及規避措施可推行的範圍。

en.title: Cambridge researchers propose altitude changes to curb persistent contrails in UK-managed airspace
en.summary: Cambridge proposes routine altitude changes for some flights in UK-managed airspace to reduce persistent contrails.
body: University of Cambridge researchers have set out a plan in a policy briefing to make flight-altitude adjustments routine in UK-administered airspace. They say climbing or descending by about 2,000 feet could allow some flights to avoid forming persistent contrails. The briefing was released during COP31 on 18 November.

The Aviation Impact Accelerator (AIA) estimates that 2–5% of flights cause 80–90% of contrail warming. Cambridge estimates that targeted avoidance could increase fuel burn by about 0.1% when averaged across an airline’s fleet.
Another estimate suggests that avoiding persistent contrails could almost halve aviation’s climate impact, though the outcome depends on forecast accuracy and how widely avoidance can be used.

zh.summary: Koala Airlines啟航計畫延至2027年，洽談租機、尋求大型飛機營運許可。
body: 彭博報導，澳洲新創航空公司Koala Airlines已將啟航計畫延至2027年。這家以墨爾本為基地的業者原本希望在2026年底前開始飛航，目前正洽談飛機租賃，並尋求營運大型噴射機的監管許可。
Koala Airlines已選定737 MAX 8作為擬議營運機型，並希望在初期幾年建立約20架波音737 MAX客機的機隊。
Koala表示，既有航空營運人許可證（AOC）須待澳洲民航安全局（CASA）簽認相關要求後，才能用於啟動737-8營運。
公司計畫將搭乘海外航空公司航班抵達的旅客，轉運至澳洲航班服務有限的目的地。

body: Australian start-up Koala Airlines has pushed its planned launch to 2027 while negotiating aircraft leases and seeking regulatory approval to operate large jets, Bloomberg reported. The Melbourne-based carrier had aimed to begin flying by the end of 2026.
Koala has chosen the 737 MAX 8 for its proposed operation and wants to build a fleet of about 20 Boeing 737 MAX jets in its first few years.
Koala says the existing air operator’s certificate (AOC) cannot be used to launch 737-8 operations until Australia’s Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) signs off on the applicable requirements.
The airline plans to carry passengers arriving on overseas airlines onward to Australian destinations with limited air service.

en.title: EASA orders inspections of eight Emirates and Etihad Airways A380s
en.summary: EASA orders inspections of eight A380s operated by Emirates and Etihad Airways.
body: The European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has issued an airworthiness directive requiring inspections of eight Airbus A380s. Seven are operated by Emirates and one by Etihad Airways.

The directive took effect on November 18, 2026. EASA said additional aircraft serial numbers may be affected by the same potential unsafe condition. The eight A380s must be inspected by January 31, 2027, in line with Airbus’ Alert Operators Transmission.

A380s stored for more than 12 months must also have their wing mid-spars inspected in accordance with the transmission before returning to service. If an inspection finds a discrepancy, Airbus must be contacted before the next flight for applicable repair instructions, which must be followed within the time specified in those instructions.

body: Baykar's Bayraktar AKINCI unmanned combat aerial vehicle released Roketsan's ORKA next-generation lightweight anti-submarine torpedo over the Gulf of Saros on November 22, in the first reported torpedo release from an unmanned aircraft. According to Anadolu Agency, the AKINCI took off from the Çorlu Flight Training and Test Center in Tekirdağ carrying the torpedo beneath its wing, released it over the designated area in the northeastern Aegean Sea, and returned to base. The torpedo separated safely from the aircraft and entered the water at the designated point.

The test did not establish a successful engagement against an underwater target. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense, citing Army Recognition, reported that the torpedo did not hit the simulated underwater target, while Army Recognition noted that the trial demonstrated a critical technical foundation for integrating torpedo weapons with unmanned combat aircraft. The result is therefore a milestone in platform-weapon integration rather than a demonstration of a complete anti-submarine engagement.

ORKA is a fully autonomous lightweight torpedo with an active and passive acoustic seeker and onboard guidance, with a range of 15 kilometres, a diameter of 275 millimetres and a weight of about 220 kilograms. The AKINCI offers around 20 hours of endurance, a 1,500-kilogram payload and satellite communications. Turkey is also testing related unmanned anti-submarine concepts: in September, a TB-3 drone launched from the amphibious assault ship TCG Anadolu dropped two sonobuoys, and future trials are expected to pair reconnaissance and strike drones with crewed aircraft in a networked system.

這次測試並未完成對水下目標的有效打擊。根據軍聞社引述軍聞網站23日報導，魚雷因技術問題未命中水下模擬目標；該網站也指出，測試未證實對水下目標的成功接戰，但已展現將魚雷武器整合至無人作戰飛機的關鍵技術基礎。這次測試應視為平台與武器整合的里程碑，而非完整反潛接戰的驗證。

ORKA是全自主輕型反潛魚雷，配備主被動聲學尋標器與自主導引系統，直徑275公厘、總重量約220公斤、射程15公里；「奇襲者」則具備20小時滯空能力、1500公斤酬載能力與衛星通訊能力。土耳其也在測試其他無人反潛構想：今年9月，兩棲突擊艦「安納杜魯號」出動艦載型TB-3武裝無人機，運用SAS-POD莢艙投放2枚聲納浮標，驗證無人機執行水下偵測任務的潛力；未來可望由無人機與有人機搭配，分別擔任偵察與打擊節點。

zh.summary: 根據Cirium數據，西南航空2026年最長的美國本土橫貫航線是波士頓—舊金山，平均2704英里；前三名航線差距僅15英里，執飛主力為737 MAX 8。
body: 西南航空以737機隊經營全美最大的國內窄體航網，雖然外界多半將其與中短程航線聯想在一起，但部分航線橫跨美國本土、逼近2700英里。根據Cirium的2026年數據，該公司最長的橫貫航線是波士頓洛根—舊金山，平均2704英里；第二名是羅德島T.F.格林—舊金山，平均2691英里；第三名是波士頓—聖荷西，平均2689英里，前三名之間僅差15英里。
其餘上榜航線依序為普羅維登斯—聖荷西，平均2675英里；第五名是波士頓—聖地牙哥，平均2588英里；第六與第七名皆自巴爾的摩／華盛頓出發，分別飛往舊金山與聖荷西，平均2457英里與2438英里。

機隊方面，737 MAX 8是這些長程航線的主力機型，可載175名乘客，最寬座椅17.8英寸，在受檢視航線上共執飛1310班次、提供229250個座位。737-800同樣可載175名乘客，執飛813班次、提供142275個座位；737-700可載137名乘客，執飛209班次、提供28770個座位。西南航空採點對點航網而非傳統樞紐輻射模式，近年並愈來愈以核心站點設計航網，同時自2025年起開辦紅眼航班，尖峰期每日紅眼航班逾50班。2027年夏季班表尖峰日航班達4498班，創歷來最多，實施期間為2027年6月3日至8月2日。

en.title: Southwest's longest transcontinental Boeing 737 routes in 2026 led by Boston–San Francisco at 2,704 miles
en.summary: Cirium data for 2026 puts Southwest Airlines' longest domestic transcontinental route at Boston Logan–San Francisco, averaging 2,704 miles, with only 15 miles separating the top three routes and the 737 MAX 8 doing most of the flying.
body: Southwest Airlines operates one of the largest domestic narrowbody networks in the US, and although the carrier is usually associated with short- and medium-haul flying, several of its routes stretch nearly 2,700 miles across the continental United States. According to Cirium data for 2026, its longest route connects Boston Logan International Airport (BOS) with San Francisco International Airport (SFO), covering an average of 2,704 miles. Rhode Island T.F. Green International Airport–San Francisco is second at 2,691 miles, and Boston–San Jose International Airport is third at 2,689 miles — just 15 miles separate the longest and third-longest services.

Providence–San Jose ranks fourth at 2,675 miles, followed by Boston–San Diego at 2,588 miles. The final two routes in the top seven both originate at Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), connecting with San Francisco and San Jose at 2,457 and 2,438 miles respectively.

The Boeing 737 MAX 8 is the primary aircraft on these routes, seating 175 passengers with its widest seats measuring 17.8 inches, and operating 1,310 flights offering a combined 229,250 available seats across the routes examined. The 737-800, also configured for 175 passengers, operated 813 flights with 142,275 available seats, while the smaller 737-700, seating 137, operated 209 flights with 28,770 available seats. Southwest runs a point-to-point network rather than the traditional hub-and-spoke model, increasingly designing its network around core stations, and introduced red-eye flights in 2025, now offering over 50 peak-day redeye flights during peak periods. Its summer 2027 schedule peaks at 4,498 trips on peak days — the most the airline has ever offered — effective June 3 to August 2, 2027.

zh.title: 北約授權E-3A預警機前進部署加強波蘭監偵 分析師盤點機隊
zh.summary: 北約授權前進部署E-3A預警機加強波蘭監偵；分析師稱6架近期曾飛行且不在維修設施。
body: 北約已授權前進部署一架波音E-3A預警機，以加強波蘭上空監偵。這項授權是在3枚俄羅斯Kh-101巡弋飛彈於11月進入波蘭領空後作出。
北約表示，其E-3A部隊共有14架飛機。分析師Steffan Watkins在更新的盤點中指出，這支機隊有6架在盤點前28天曾飛行，且當時不在維修設施內。
波音E-3A是1980年代的雷達機，以四具引擎的波音707客機為基礎。北約表示，預警機蒐集的訊息可透過數位連結，直接傳送給地面、海上或空中的其他使用者。

en.title: NATO authorizes E-3A forward deployment for Poland surveillance; analyst reviews fleet
en.summary: NATO authorizes E-3A deployment for surveillance over Poland; analyst says six flew recently and were outside maintenance facilities.
body: NATO has authorized the forward deployment of a Boeing E-3A AWACS aircraft to reinforce surveillance over Poland. The authorization followed the entry of three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles into Polish airspace in November.
NATO says its E-3A Component has 14 aircraft. In an updated post, analyst Steffan Watkins said six of the fleet had flown in the preceding 28 days and were not at a maintenance facility.

The E-3A is a 1980s-era radar aircraft based on the four-engine Boeing 707 airliner. NATO says information collected by AWACS can be transmitted directly through digital links to users on land, at sea or in the air.
